why_it_moved.text: The scorecard has no segment cuts, so the mechanism behind the small rise in Successful Search Rate is unknown.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: More users until the Successful Search Rate range excludes the 0.50% bar would close the test as no lift worth having.
A Successful Search Rate reading at or above the 0.50% bar on the extended run, with every guardrail within its margin, would clear it.
A pre-exposure comparison and a daily series by days since first exposure would fill the two checks that could not run.
